Module com.mathcat.mathcat
Package com.mathcat.mathcat.models

Interface IQuestion

All Known Implementing Classes:
Question
public interface IQuestion
Defines the contract for a math question presented to the user. Implementations are responsible for generating operands, computing the answer, and formatting the question text.
